workItem: P8.62 User-Observed Graph Delta Approval Workbench Review Request

reviewTarget.sourcePhase: P8.60 Static Graph Delta Approval Workbench Prototype
reviewTarget.blockedAutomationPhase: P8.61 Static Graph Delta Approval Workbench Visual/Interaction Dry Run Attempt

whyUserReviewIsRequired: The graph workbench must be judged by actual interaction quality, not just structural HTML validation.
The in-app browser automation could load the local page but policy blocked further automated interaction.
The coordinator specifically requires Graphify-grade graph movement, zoom, selection, diff visibility, and inspectability.

reviewChecklist.prompt: Open the HTML and confirm the graph is visible, not blank.
Judge whether the graph presentation is materially close to Graphify-grade inspectability.
Drag the graph canvas and confirm the graph moves.
Zoom in and zoom out with controls or wheel input and confirm nodes/edges remain readable.
Use Fit and confirm the graph returns to a usable full view.
Select a graph node and confirm the right inspector panel shows node information.
Select a graph edge and confirm the right inspector panel shows edge information.
Select deltaStep.p8.44-apply-preflight.apply and confirm affected nodes/edges are highlighted.
Select code.file.intentgraph-preflight and confirm the code diff panel shows the PowerShell file diff.
Select proposal.p8.43-preflight and confirm the graph diff panel shows before/after node payload and changed fields.
Select edge.proposal-to-code-file and confirm the graph diff panel shows before/after edge payload and changed fields.

acceptableResponses.meaning: The workbench is good enough to continue to the next non-productization gate.
The workbench is not good enough. Provide what failed or what felt below Graphify-grade, and the next phase must revise the workbench.
The HTML cannot be opened or reviewed in the current environment.

doNotAcceptIf: The graph is blank or visually broken.
Zoom makes the graph unusable or unreadable.
Nodes and edges cannot be selected.
Selected node or edge details do not appear.
Code node selection does not show code diff.
Changed node selection does not show before/after graph node diff.
Changed edge selection does not show before/after graph edge diff.
The result feels materially worse than Graphify-style graph inspection.
recommendedUserMessage: Open the P8.60 graph workbench HTML, try the checklist, then reply with accept, revise, or blocked.
